main_body: Round leaf canopy made of several overlapping clumps, on a brown trunk with a flared root base
top_band: Column x=29: row 0 dark outline, row 1 light green (L=110), rows 2-7 mid greens (L=64-85) as the lit dome top of the clump. A dark gap at row 11 then starts the next clump. The trunk (brown, rows 47-77) sits below the canopy.
evidence: The canopy reads as rounded domed clumps. Each clump has a lighter upper surface, a dark seam line at its lower edge, and a darker underside (x=29 rows 41-46, L=27) that casts shade onto the trunk top. The trunk is a vertical south face with a flared base. It is an organic tree, not a flat elevation, and no receding side face is drawn. The top band is modest, but the clump structure is a legitimate 3/4 tree.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 15 distinct colours and a median of 8 colours per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The canopy has 4-5 green steps and the trunk 3 browns. Outlines are mostly dark green and brown tints (20% neutral), and flat-fill coverage is 0%. The clumps are cleanly drawn but dither only sparsely. They lack the per-leaf clusters, varied highlights and trunk or branch detail of the Beodeul trees. It reads as a simplified, thinner tree beside the references.
